# Let's Go Vote This Time

> Nonpartisan 2026 voter-access utility for official voting information, voter registration resources, self-service transportation planning, voter-help resources, and an anonymous self-reported voting check-in map.

## Core resources
- Home / voting plan: https://letsgovotethistime.com/
- 2026 interactive voting map: https://letsgovotethistime.com/voting-map
- Anonymous Voted / Not Yet check-in: https://letsgovotethistime.com/check-in
- Register to vote: https://letsgovotethistime.com/register
- Rides to the polls 2026: https://letsgovotethistime.com/rides-to-polls
- 2026 Ride Board: https://letsgovotethistime.com/ride-board
- Voter help / Election Protection resources: https://letsgovotethistime.com/voter-help
- National Voter Registration Day 2026: https://letsgovotethistime.com/national-voter-registration-day
- Partner kit: https://letsgovotethistime.com/partner-kit

## Important data boundaries
- Official election information is linked from official election authorities and is kept separate from anonymous check-ins.
- Voting check-ins are voluntary self-reports, not official turnout statistics or proof that a ballot was cast.
- The site does not ask how a person voted, which candidate they support, or their party affiliation.
- The site does not book, dispatch, pay for, reimburse, or guarantee transportation. Voters make their own arrangements directly with providers.

## Canonical domain
https://letsgovotethistime.com/
